subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Chaste
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"chaste"** means morally pure or abstaining from extramarital, or from all, sexual intercourse. (शुद्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **She lived a **chaste** life, dedicated to her spiritual beliefs.
 
 
 
• **"Pure" **refers to something that is not mixed or adulterated with any other substance or material; it also means morally clean. (शुद्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **The water from the mountain spring is **pure **and refreshing.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'chaste' **is **'pure'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flashy **(चमकीला): Ostentatiously attractive or impressive.

 
 
• **Example:** He wore a **flashy** suit that caught everyone's attention.
 
 
 
• **Sullied **(मैला): Made dirty or impure.
 
 
• **Example: **Her reputation was **sullied **by false accusations.
 
 
 
• **Corrupt** (भ्रष्ट): Dishonestly exploiting one's power for personal gain.
 
 
• **Example:** The **corrupt** official was finally arrested for accepting bribes.
